reviews.review: This is such a magical game that is rare nowadays, 100% recommend!

This game (and others in the series) is pure chaos. This is why we play it. If you have a friend or 3 to play with, you're guaranteed to have a blast while fighting against aliens to prove you eat more glue than them. EDF 6 is way better for obvious reasons (its gameplay is more advanced and even the story is insane) but this one comes first in the story. If you want to know what the hell is going on in EDF 6, get this one. If you don't care, get EDF 6 instead, it is better.

What you will be doing in this game is fight against aliens who came from outerspace (duh), you will encounter different enemy types as you progress and unlock new and stronger weapons as the aliens will also gain in power.
 You can also choose between 5 difficulties [Easy / Normal / Hard / Hardest / Inferno] but will only be able to play easy-hard until you complete every mission. This helps keep balance as some missions are way easier than others (some even being completed while you are afk) and Inferno will give you the highest level weapons.
Your choices of class will be:

Ranger: The classic good ol' man with a rifle. This one is able to sprint, hold 2 weapons while also being able to upgrade his sprint ability or call a vehicle (you choose)
If your minecraft skin is Steve, you eat plain cereal or drink regular water, this one is for you.

Air raider: If you're crazy this one is for you, it will summon death from the sky (air raids) and annihilate absolutely everything in its path, it was designed to be a support class but it can absolutely be played and enjoyed solo. With 3 weapon slots and a vehicle slot, the possibilities are insane.

Wing diver: It can fly. This is gonna be your glass cannon. it has a unique energy system that you're gonna need to reload your weapons and fly/dash. It is incredibly strong but at the cost of light armor. If hit and run suits you, this one is for you. Comes with 2 weapon slots and 1 jetpack core slot (so you can upgrade your jetpack and energy consumption)

Fencer: The heavy guy. The tank. some may also call it GOD. This one is seen as the heavy powerful slowpoke of the bunch but it can also be the fastest, depends on your play style. He will gain armor way faster than every other class, maybe even twice as fast as wing diver, his whole purpose is to be tanky. What does he do? He destroys, literally, he can send a car flying just by touching it with his toe. He comes with 4 weapon slots, 2 for each loadout. Some of them allow you to dash and jump high, which is how you're gonna be the flash of this universe, while some are 15 meters long missiles or reflective shields. He also has 2 Exoskeleton modifier slots which you can use to remove all recoil, weapon slowing effects or get extra dash and boost.

I got this one and the 6th on a huge 70% discount, waiting will definitely be worth it if you want it.
And you do want it.
Buy it.
Now.

Fun solo, great with friends. This isn't some graphical masterpiece. The gameplay isn't deep. The story is taken as seriously as a whoopie cushion. This is just dumb, satisfying fun. It's an over-the-top game where you battle hordes of giant insects in a city where the command to cause minimal damage is an invitation to level the city. My favorite small detail? The singing. Yes, everyone knows you can lead a squad of units into battle and start a song, then they'll sing the next verse. But they have access to ones you don't, and will sometimes sing them in appropriate circumstances. Playing a cave level with the squad on full health? They'll sing a song about going into caves to kill aliens. But same level, later on after they've taken damage? They'll sing a similar song, except more depressed, about how the expectations placed on them may be too great. And you can't access those ones, so it just has to happen without your input. It's beayotiful. ♪ Oh, we are the valiant infantry! We are the alpha team with passion and camaraderie! ♪
